in_hindi.name: Manendra
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler of the Mind
in_hindi.long_meaning: Manendra एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Manendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'manas' (mind) and 'indra' (ruler). This name signifies someone who rules over their mind and thoughts, showing strength, wisdom, and control. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of the gods and the god of rain and thunder. Manendra is a powerful and inspiring name for a boy, evoking images of leadership and inner strength.
